next.reason: Same. 1985: minimum and maximum record sizes are 'established at the time the file is created and must not subsequently be changed'. 2023 states it in uncataloged prose, §2023:9.1.6: attributes that 'apply to the file at the time it is created and cannot be changed throughout the lifetime of the file' include 'the minimum and maximum logical record size in bytes'; the cataloged rule that applies it is §2023:14.9.27.4 GR10, where the program's attributes 'are compared with the fixed file attributes of the file' and a mismatch fails the OPEN with '39', as the 1985 file attribute conflict condition (XIII.4.5.4 GR6) does.
